name: dpi-terminal-adapter
description: The selected terminal UI as a remote dpi-sdk client, without a Durable runtime owner.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node --input-type=module -e "import { cpSync } from 'node:fs'; for (const n of ['dark.json','light.json','theme-schema.json']) cpSync('src/ui/modes/interactive/theme/'+n,'dist/ui/modes/interactive/theme/'+n); cpSync('src/ui/licenses','dist/ui/licenses',{recursive:true}); cpSync('src/ui/SOURCE.json','dist/ui/SOURCE.json');"
